source.citation: Hu et al. (2026), Riverine input and eddy edge effects on microeukaryotic biodiversity in the Northern Gulf. bioRxiv preprint, posted 21 July 2026, DOI 10.64898/2026.07.20.739614.
source.primary_text_access: Indexed author-uploaded preprint text on ResearchGate; original bioRxiv PDF returned HTTP 429 and author-upload PDF returned HTTP 403. Figure pixels are independently acquired from the author repository, not from the inaccessible preprint PDF.

source_case_association.source_text_locator: Results, PDF pages 13–14, manuscript lines 285–292; Data Availability, PDF page 13, lines 268–271.
source_case_association.basis: Indexed primary text names Atwater southwest of the late-July/early-August 2023 transect and links the author project. The isolated high-SSH image patch southwest of the station strip is the candidate used here. The image itself has no Atwater label.

field_qualification.basis: Preprint methods and related repository code identify a HYCOM workflow, but the exact old CW GIF export is not reproduced by the reviewed code. Its full-Gulf axes and 0–1 m legend differ from the later zoomed code output.
code_hazards: The SSHa iframe repeats SSH_CW_resized.gif; section heading does not establish anomaly type.
Commented frame numbers 98/117/122 cannot date this four-frame GIF. Use actual visible frame titles.
Raw MATLAB fields and exact generating environment were not acquired or processed.

operator.definition: Largest eight-connected matching source-colour patch above the OSW-chosen legend level inside an explicit ROI, no hole filling or gap repair. The arbitrary level is a diagnostic choice, not an author boundary.
operator.axis_rule: Three labelled longitude and latitude anchors; piecewise linear degree and Mercator latitude interpolation are both included because exact source projection is not verified. Independent ±2 pixel shifts of all six anchors plus six-pixel extent allowance; 384 scenarios per component; 6371 km sphere; outward rounding to 25 km.
operator.margin_kind: Image selection and reading sensitivity only, not source-field uncertainty, confidence, natural variability or seasonal extrema.
operator.source_palette_duplicate_rule: Read all 774 coloured legend pixels; collapse duplicate RGB to the lowest matching level, 134 unique colours. Squared RGB distance <=900; smallest level wins equal-distance ties.
operator.component_gate: More than 1000 selected pixels and more than ten times the next component; all extents plus six pixels strictly inside the ROI.
